Go to a beach. Find a conch shell. Put it to your ear. What do you hear? That’s right. “Meta.” 

It’s a name we hear all the time, alongside its founder Mark Zuckerberg. But what does Meta – formerly Facebook – actually do now? Lets uncover. 

Alex Heath, independent journalist and creator of the newsletter “Sources.” It’s a great newsletter, subscribe: https://sources.news/

Mike Isaac, Silicon Valley Correspondent at the New York Times. Follow Mike here: https://x.com/MikeIsaac

A bunch of anonymous current/former Meta employees. 

Mark Mahaney, Senior Managing Director at Evercore and head of their internet research team. Follow Mark here: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mark-mahaney-433bb0/
